summary_i18n.en: AAOI reported Q2 2026 revenue of $191.9 million, up 86% year over year, with data-center revenue of $107.7 million, up 140%, while 800G volumes more than doubled sequentially. Management guided Q3 revenue to $255 million-$290 million and said demand for 800G and 1.6T products could exceed capacity through about mid-2027. Key catalysts include more than $124 million of 800G orders from one major hyperscaler since March, a separate 1.6T volume order worth over $200 million from a long-standing customer, and expected 1.6T shipments beginning in the second half of 2026. Multi-year ties with MSFT, warrants granted in 2025 to an AMZN affiliate that can vest based on up to $4 billion of purchases, and Texas capacity expansion toward about 650,000 units per month by end-2026 plus roughly 350% laser capacity growth by end-2027 support the view that AAOI could become strategically important in U.S. AI optics and ex-China supply chains; DOCSIS 4.0 also provides a second growth engine. Key tickers: $AAOI, $MSFT, $AMZN

items.summary: $TSSI被定义为$DELL AI服务器浪潮的高弹性代理：戴尔卖出AI机架后，TSSI负责机架集成、布线、测试和发货。尽管财报后股价因总营收下滑20%而大跌24%，但更高毛利的系统集成业务上季仍增长46%、占收入39%，公司主动压缩低毛利采购业务后毛利率创多年新高、EBITDA在低收入下仍增长12%。结合$DELL、$SMCI、$HPE对AI服务器需求的积极信号，以及TSSI约1.3倍滚动营收、按指引高端约9倍EV/EBITDA和约5200万美元净现金，观点认为市场把有效的结构升级误判成业务恶化。

summary_i18n.en: $TSSI is framed as a high-beta proxy for Dell’s AI server wave: after Dell sells an AI rack, TSSI handles rack integration, cabling, testing, and shipping. Although the stock fell 24% after earnings because total revenue declined 20%, the higher-margin systems integration segment still grew 46% last quarter to 39% of revenue, and after deliberately shrinking low-margin procurement, gross margin hit a multi-year high while EBITDA still rose 12% on lower volume. Combined with positive AI server demand signals from $DELL, $SMCI, and $HPE, plus TSSI trading at roughly 1.3x trailing sales, about 9x EV/EBITDA on the top end of guidance, and holding about $52M net cash, the view is that the market misread a successful business mix upgrade as deterioration.

summary_i18n.en: Building on the quoted post that described Arc as a platform connecting warehouse and manufacturing systems while orchestrating other robots, this thread frames Agility Robotics—set to merge into CCXI and become AGLT—as a combined robotics, software, and services platform. Digit has accumulated more than 65,000 operating hours across nine customer facilities; GXO converted a pilot into a multi-year RaaS agreement; Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada signed a commercial RaaS deal; MELI is deploying in Texas; AMZN has tested and invested; and NVDA selected Agility as the first humanoid company to integrate parts of its Halos safety architecture. Management's model suggests about $500,000 of five-year cumulative revenue per robot under RaaS or roughly $400,000 through an upfront sale plus recurring services, and this is paired with RoboFab capacity of up to 10,000 robots annually, a U.S.-leaning supply chain, and partners such as Ricoh. The bullish case ultimately depends on deployment counts, uptime, customer expansion, and improving unit economics. Key tickers: $CCXI, $AGLT, $MELI, $AMZN, $NVDA

items.summary: NVDA Blackwell 已经让机架制造与测试更复杂，而 Rubin 还会更难，包含液冷回路、热验证、长时间 burn-in 和更多线缆，这使 DELL 的外部测试伙伴 TSSI 受益。推文称 DELL 5 月要求 TSSI 追加 1700 万美元做电力与冷却改造以准备 Rubin，项目 9 月完成，且双方为多年度合同并设有按机架计的周最低量。核心判断是：当每个 Rubin 机架测试工时上升、DELL 自有产线趋满时，TSSI 的收入地板被抬高，天花板也更接近。 重点标的: $DELL., $TSSI.

summary_i18n.en: Blackwell has already made rack manufacturing and testing more complex, and Rubin should be even harder, with liquid loops, thermal validation, longer burn-in, and more cabling, which benefits TSSI as Dell’s external testing partner. The post says Dell asked TSSI in May to spend $17 million on power and cooling upgrades to get Rubin-ready, with completion in September, under a multi-year contract with weekly minimums measured in racks. The core call is that if each Rubin rack requires more testing hours and Dell’s own lines fill up, TSSI’s revenue floor rises while its upside ceiling becomes more reachable. Key tickers: $DELL., $TSSI.

items.summary: 这条推文明确偏多 $NBIS 和 $CRWV：以 $NBIS 1-3年合同为例，单MW年合同额约2000万至2500万美元、现金利润率约55%，对应年现金流约1240万美元，约1年10个月即可覆盖约2000万至2300万美元的全口径CAPEX，4-5年生命周期下累计现金流远高于投入，NPV约每MW正2000万至2500万美元、IRR接近50%。推文进一步引用 $CRWV 1040亿美元 take-or-pay backlog、A100 合同延续到2029年、H100 到期后以原价95%迅速续租，以及 $NVDA 对项目最高25%残值提供背书，说明GPU残值不必很高也能成立；真正关键是已签约年份不能失效。若GPU折旧寿命从3-4年重估到5-6年，$CRWV、$NBIS 乃至 hyperscalers 的盈利能力都有上修空间。

summary_i18n.en: This tweet is clearly bullish on $NBIS and $CRWV. Using $NBIS 1-3 year contracts as an example, annual contract value is about $20-25 million per MW and cash margin is about 55%, implying roughly $12.4 million of annual cash flow per MW; that means all-in capex of about $20-23 million per MW can be recovered in roughly 1 year and 10 months, while 4-5 years of asset life produces cumulative cash flow far above initial investment, with NPV of about positive $20-25 million per MW and IRR near 50%. The tweet further cites $CRWV’s $104 billion take-or-pay backlog, an A100 contract extending into 2029, H100 capacity being rebooked at 95% of the original rate after expiry, and $NVDA underwriting up to 25% residual value, arguing that the thesis does not require high GPU residual values; the real requirement is that contracted years perform. If GPU depreciation life is rerated from 3-4 years to 5-6 years, earnings power for $CRWV, $NBIS, and even hyperscalers could move materially higher.
